text.en: Windows GitHub updates use single Range requests for native differential downloads, avoiding full-download fallback when multipart ranges are rejected.
text.zh-CN: Windows GitHub 更新使用单段 Range 进行原生差分下载，避免多段请求被拒绝后回退为完整下载。

text.en: New image searches refresh confirmed mismatch history before starting, including results saved after conversation preparation.
text.zh-CN: 新找图任务开始前重新读取已确认的不匹配历史，避免会话准备期间新增的排除结果遗漏。

text.en: Stopping a conversation cancels its Visual Curator tasks, and cancelled background tasks no longer restart an idle conversation.
text.zh-CN: 停止会话时同步取消其视觉策展任务，已取消的后台任务不再自动唤醒会话。
